slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total cost of the tables ordered, or is there a different objective such as maximizing the number of tables or meeting a specific supplier mix
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is cost minimization.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier A requires ordering at least 30 tables from Supplier B. The questions about per-supplier order limits do not cover this conditional link.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C, nor did it explicitly mark this hidden fact as needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no requirement that ordering from Supplier A forces at least 30 tables to be ordered from Supplier B; supplier A and B orders are independent.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about this conditional constraint, and the READY_TO_MODEL confirmed constraints omit any A-to-B linkage.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no requirement that ordering from Supplier B implies also ordering from Supplier C; supplier B and C orders are independent.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about this conditional constraint, and the READY_TO_MODEL confirmed constraints omit any B-to-C linkage.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 conditional supplier-link constraints H2 and H3 remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective and basic order constraints, but it stopped before probing the two important conditional supplier-link constraints, silently modeling A/B and B/C orders as independent.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
